raw_model_deviations.issue: The article presents the test as having actually caused this surprise, while the source describes a test that suggested or evoked such a scenario. raw_model_deviations.explanation: The wording changes a scenario suggested by the test into an actual effect of the test, adding an unverified claim about surprise. This is a limited overstatement, not a major change to the article’s central account of the human-staffed calls.
raw_model_deviations.qualifier_text: A call seemed to come from an AI agent.

But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all.
